_comment: Knobs a catalog entry names that its model does not declare, and that are
not defects. There is one legitimate kind: an entry that names a knob in
order to say it does not exist. Anything else here is a bug being deferred.
The gate blocks nothing about this file's size — unlike the doc-pointer
baseline it is not a ratchet, because the population is one. If it starts
growing, that is the signal to make it one.

undeclared.name: rib_mm
undeclared.why: Named to disown it. The entry reads: 'an earlier version of this entry prescribed `--param rib_mm=…`, a knob that never existed.' Rib thickness is a brickFit offset reached by --brick-fit, not a param — no `brick` statement reads one. Deleting the mention would delete the correction.
